summary: Serves as the core package for managing docstring updates, encompassing file update execution, rendering, validation, and specialized error handling.
responsibilities: Handle docstring update operations including file updates, merges, rendering, and validation.
Define custom exceptions and error types specific to docstring update failures.
relationships: Docstring update planning depends on building update plans and merge plans, rendering docstrings, and validating sources.
Error handling defines custom exceptions related to docstring update failures.
design_decisions: Encapsulates modules for building, merging, applying, and validating file and docstring updates, alongside custom error handling for update operations.
